create.name: Jodie Cruz
create.bio:
Jodie Cruz is an Australian Quantum-Touch practitioner and Level 1 instructor who works entirely at a distance through her practice, Connected Heart Healing. Before turning to energy work she spent seventeen years as a zookeeper looking after Australian wildlife, and that close experience of animals runs through her practice today. She first received a Quantum-Touch session from a friend in 2007, went on to take workshops at all five levels, certified as a practitioner in 2013 and qualified to teach Level 1 in 2025. She returned to Australia after several years living in Hawaii.

She describes Quantum-Touch as the whole of her work rather than one tool among many. Her hour-long sessions run over video or phone: a short conversation to set an intention, a quiet period in which the client rests at home while she sends energy, and a closing talk about what she noticed. She offers the same format for companion animals, which stay in their own surroundings throughout. She also teaches the two-day Level 1 workshop, Becoming Energised, live on Zoom, and holds a monthly online practice circle for people who have completed it.

courses.title: Distance Healing Sessions
courses.description: Sixty-minute Quantum-Touch sessions held fully online: a brief video or phone check-in, a period of rest at home while Jodie does the energy work, and a follow-up conversation. Packages of three or five sessions are also available.

courses.title: Animal Energy Healing Sessions
courses.description: Remote Quantum-Touch sessions for companion animals, which stay in their own familiar space while Jodie works. Each hour includes a check-in with the owner beforehand and a talk afterwards about how the animal responded.

courses.title: Virtual Level 1 Becoming Energised (November 2026)
courses.description: The two-day foundation workshop of Quantum-Touch, taught live on Zoom: breathing and body-awareness practice, focused intention, chakra toning and distance work, for use with people and animals. No experience is needed and graduates join her monthly practice circle.

courses.title: Virtual Level 1 Becoming Energised (December 2026)
courses.description: A second run of her two-day online Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop, following the official curriculum with live demonstrations and paired practice over Zoom. Open to beginners.
